description: Switch LLM from kimi-k2.6:cloud to deepseek-v4-flash, reduce maxTokens from 8192 to 4096, increase timeout from 45s to 120s. Also added comprehensive error logging throughout pipeline.

asi.hypothesis: Kimi-k2.6:cloud returns empty responses on Ollama Cloud with our API key. Switching to deepseek-v4-flash which successfully generates content.

description: Store call_id in pipeline_status at checkout creation; replace pending_transcript with pending_payment; stop deleting transcripts after pipeline runs

asi.hypothesis: Transcript deletion after pipeline runs causes race conditions on retry. Storing call_id early and keeping transcripts enables resilient retry flows.

description: Baseline: analyzeTranscript with maxTokens=4096, timeout=120s, temperature=0.5 on 11,445-char transcript. DeepSeek-v4-flash model. Result: 5,782 chars JSON in 22,397ms.

asi.hypothesis: Establish baseline for LLM analysis latency. Current config: deepseek-v4-flash, maxTokens=4096, timeoutMs=120000, temperature=0.5. Output JSON is 5782 chars (~1400-1800 tokens).

description: Reduced maxTokens from 4096 to 3072. Result: 38,528ms - significantly worse than 22,397ms baseline. Likely cause: model generated more slowly with lower cap or needed a retry.

asi.hypothesis: Reducing maxTokens from 4096 to 3072 would reduce generation latency since output is only ~5800 chars.
asi.next_action_hint: Try JSON mode (format: 'json') or lower temperature to reduce sampling variance instead of constraining token budget.
asi.rollback_reason: Metric worsened by +72% (38.5s vs 22.4s). Lower maxTokens may have caused the inference engine to behave differently with deepseek-v4-flash:cloud.

description: Attempted to switch OLLAMA_MODEL to deepseek-4-fast:cloud per user request. Model returned 404 not found from ollama.com. Reverted to deepseek-v4-flash:cloud.

asi.hypothesis: deepseek-4-fast:cloud model would be faster per user's stated agreement.
asi.next_action_hint: Try JSON mode (format: 'json') or lower temperature with the existing deepseek-v4-flash:cloud model.
asi.rollback_reason: Model deepseek-4-fast:cloud does not exist on Ollama server.

description: Added format: 'json' (response_format: {type: 'json_object'}) to enable structured generation. Result: 42,896ms - significantly slower than 22,397ms baseline (+92%). Model or provider handles JSON mode inefficiently.

asi.hypothesis: JSON mode (response_format) would speed up structured generation and reduce invalid JSON.
asi.next_action_hint: Try lowering temperature from 0.5 to 0.2 for faster deterministic generation, or add parallel tool lookup.
asi.rollback_reason: JSON mode made the model 92% slower. Ollama provider's constrained decoding may be slow for deepseek-v4-flash:cloud.

description: Reduced temperature from 0.5 to 0.2. Result: 40,923ms - significantly worse than 22,397ms baseline (+83%). High variance across experiments suggests benchmark noise from external API. Need variance check.

asi.hypothesis: Lower temperature (0.2) would reduce sampling randomness and speed up deterministic generation.
asi.next_action_hint: Run multiple unchanged baselines to measure API variance before trusting single-run comparisons.
asi.rollback_reason: 40s vs 22s baseline. Either temperature hurt, or API was slower this run. Need variance data.

description: Filter user utterances: remove Agent: lines from transcript before LLM analysis. 39% prompt reduction (11,445 chars -> 6,939 chars). Result: 94,902 ms - far above typical 36-49s baseline. Likely API variance; no evidence that smaller prompt improved latency on this shared inference endpoint.

asi.comparison_to_baseline: Baseline range 36-49s; this run 95s is ~2x slower.
asi.filter_logic: Removed lines starting with /^\s*Agent:/i from transcript before buildAnalysisMessages.
asi.hypothesis: Removing scripted agent voice lines reduces prompt size by ~40% and speeds up LLM analysis.
asi.likely_cause: External API variance on Ollama inference backend; single-run unreliable.
asi.next_action_hint: Run a simultaneous witness baseline (same commit, no filter) on next experiment to isolate true effect.

description: Witness baseline — 3-trial median on unchanged code. Trials: 43.5s, 61.9s, 63.5s. Confirms extreme API variance (±45%) on shared Ollama endpoint. Single-run comparisons unreliable.

asi.comparison_to_run3_baseline: Previous single-run baseline was 22,397ms (run 3). This 3-trial median is 61,892ms, confirming high variance.
asi.hypothesis: Run 3-trial median to measure API variance before trusting single-run comparisons.
asi.next_action_hint: Try prompt-size reduction (remove full JSON example from system prompt) using 3-trial comparison against this new baseline.
asi.tooling: Added scripts/bench-pipeline-3x.mjs for N-trial median benchmarks.
